read.notes: Read non-secret repo state, generated artifacts, workflow inventory, docs, and public-safe media metadata.

draft.notes: Create non-public concepts, scripts, render proofs, product metadata, queues, and tracking records.

workflow_edit.notes: Safe reversible workflow/template edits are allowed and must be documented.

workflow_execute.notes: Do not execute workflows that publish, spend money, change credentials, or touch production data without Daniel approval.

secretPolicy: Never expose passwords, API keys, OAuth access tokens, refresh tokens, service-account secrets, payment credentials, or private authentication material.

productionRequirements.voices: Distinct, consistent, original character-appropriate voices. Capture delivery characteristics, never default to unauthorized exact voice-actor cloning or impersonation. Track provider/voice ID, version, commercial rights and consent/provenance before release.

originalVoiceProfileDrafts.delivery: Concise, dry, controlled articulation; restrained energy and brief rhetorical pauses, without a romantic affectation
originalVoiceProfileDrafts.identity: Original voice, not an actor soundalike
originalVoiceProfileDrafts.canonConstraint: Editorial performance direction only; check characterization against each selected story state

originalVoiceProfileDrafts.delivery: Clear conversational analytical delivery, curious questions, audible distinction between fact and interpretation; no exaggerated announcer affect

productionRequirements.visuals: Stronger character/scene visuals with consistency, shot variety and state-appropriate references; documented asset rights, no automatic reuse of source images.
productionRequirements.editing: Purposeful motion, shot rhythm, emphasis and transitions serving the argument; improve beyond text cards without changing sourced claims.
productionRequirements.audioDesign: Music/SFX where appropriate, original or commercially cleared and mixed beneath intelligible dialogue; never required merely to fill silence.
productionRequirements.captions: Phrase-level captions tied to actual audio, readable mobile-safe positioning and human listening review before release

reusableFormats.useWhen: A short invented exchange helps expose an interpretation worth checking against canon
reusableFormats.alternatives: Choose character analysis, lore, comparison, theory or other suitable formats when an interview adds no value

editorialConfiguration.authority: Daniel editorial preference; separate from neutral sourced canon, never canon evidence

ramSubaru.ownerInterpretation: Ram comes to genuinely respect and trust Subaru more than she openly admits while finding him annoying/goofy and treating him accordingly.
ramSubaru.constraint: This is Daniel's interpretation, not a timeless canon fact. Establish support separately at each selected story state. Do not promote Ram/Subaru as a romantic pairing.
ramSubaru.episode33: Assistance is sourced canon; degree of trust/respect is analysis. Neither romance nor unconditional trust follows without separate evidence. Do not infer absence of trust from compliance with an instruction.

shippingPreferences.openTo: Rem-Subaru-Emilia outcome as editorial preference only
shippingPreferences.cruschSubaru: Speculative/fantasy shipping only, not established canon

spoilerPolicy.ownerKnowledgeCeiling: Arc 10; not permission to use later knowledge in public content
spoilerPolicy.rule: Scope claims, character knowledge and interpretation to the selected arc/event and audience boundary. No later-state leakage or disguised heavy spoilers presented as hints.

futureDiscovery.priority: Actual current fandom claims/hot takes in Reddit, comments and social discussion, then prove, disprove or qualify against sourced canon
futureDiscovery.evidenceRequired: Record a real source URL, observation date and precise claim; distinguish one comment from measured trend evidence
futureDiscovery.prohibited: Fabricated trending claims, invented audience consensus or unsupported popularity metrics
futureDiscovery.implementationStatus: Bounded manual discovery intake, ranking and format research handoff implemented; no crawler or verified trend detector

brands.primaryGoal: Create high-quality anime commentary and character-interview packages that reach READY_FOR_APPROVAL before public publishing.
rules: Do not use ripped, cropped, mirrored, or sped-up anime clips as the production base.
Prefer original narration, original compositions, motion graphics, generated supporting visuals, user-created assets, and licensed or public-domain material.
Reject fabricated canon quotes and unsupported lore claims.
Public publishing requires Daniel approval and verified brand account mapping.
